entities.name: Nikola Đurišić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikola Đurišić is a Serbian professional basketball player for the Mega Superbet of the Serbian League (KLS) and the ABA League, on loan from Crvena zvezda. Đurišić began his professional career playing for Mega Basket in Serbia, and was drafted with the 43rd overall pick in the 2024 NBA draft by the Miami Heat.
